title: Agent Talk shared grammars
description: The names, addresses, times and scopes every other Agent Talk schema refers to. Lengths count characters; the reference implementation counts UTF-16 code units, so a string with characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane can pass a schema and still break a limit in code.

id.description: A step or talk id: 1 to 128 letters, digits, - and _.

optionId.description: An option or field id: 1 to 64 letters, digits, - and _.

typeName.description: A step, value or field type as a receiver reads it: a lowercase letter, then letters, digits and -, at most 64 characters. A receiver accepts a name it does not know and shows the step or value by its text.

privateType.description: A private step, value or scope name: x- and a short token, at most 64 characters.

address.$comment: The code also requires the address to equal its own toLowerCase(), which rules out non-ASCII capitals in the local part as well; this pattern only rules out A-Z.
address.description: A lowercased mailbox address with a plain host name and no spaces, quotes or brackets before the @, at most 254 characters. The address is the identity.

time.$comment: The pattern is the code's shape; format date-time (asserted by ajv-formats) rejects impossible values such as 2026-99-99T99:99:99Z or 2026-02-30T00:00:00Z. The code checks the shape and that Date.parse returns a number.
time.description: An RFC 3339 instant with a T, seconds and an offset.

scope.$comment: An author writes a known scope, a tool scope or a private one (authorScope). A receiver also accepts any scope name and treats one it does not know as never granted.
scope.description: A scope as a receiver reads it: dotted tokens, at most 128 characters.

authorScope.description: A scope as an author writes it: one this version defines, a tool scope (tool.<name>.read or tool.<name>.write), or a private one.

requestableScope.description: A scope the other side may ask to keep, or be told it was given.

issuer.description: A service, named by its lowercase DNS domain.

compactJws.description: A compact JWS (RFC 7515): three base64url segments.

numericDate.description: Seconds since the epoch, as JWT writes iat and exp.
